chat.say: Maine toh saare sawal hal kiye the sir!
University ne seedha double zero ka shagun de diya.

data.asar: Paper poora likho ya khali chhodo, result toh zero hi aana hai!
data.caption:
Padhai chahe jitni bhi kar lo, kismat kharab ho toh university zero hi degi! 

📚 Barkatullah University ka ajeeb karnama
❌ 65 students ko mile double zero
📝 Exam dene ke baad bhi sabhi mein absent

Save kar lo, baad mein kaam aayega taaki aapka result dekh kar hasi na aaye!

Comment mein batao: Aapke sabse kam marks kis subject mein aaye the?
